model_annotation: This figure consists of two side-by-side stacked bar charts, both illustrating government investment expenditure as a percentage of GDP (labeled "% des BIP¹") over time from 1991 to 2023, broken down by three levels of government: Bund (federal, shown in blue), Länder (states, shown in purple/mauve), and Gemeinden (municipalities, shown in green). A black line overlays each chart representing "Gebietskörperschaften insgesamt" (total territorial authorities). Both charts share the same vertical axis scale ranging from −0.5 to 3.5 percent of GDP, with tick marks at 0.5 intervals, and both feature a vertical dashed line near the year 1998–1999 annotated with an arrow labeled "Bahnreform²" (railway reform). The horizontal axis in both charts displays years from 1991 to 2023, with labels at approximately five-year intervals. In the left chart, the stacked bars show the absolute levels of investment, with total values starting at approximately 3.2% of GDP in 1991, declining to a low of around 2.1% near 2005, and then gradually recovering to approximately 2.9% by 2023; the blue Bund component ranges from roughly 0.5% to 1.0%, the purple Länder component contributes approximately 0.5% to 0.8%, and the green Gemeinden component adds roughly 0.8% to 1.2% across the time series. In the right chart, the stacked bars appear to represent year-over-year changes or deviations, with values fluctuating much closer to zero, generally ranging between approximately −0.3% and 0.7% of GDP; the bars in the early 1990s show positive values around 0.5–0.7%, then turn slightly negative or near zero through the 2000s and 2010s, with a modest positive uptick around 2020 reaching approximately 0.4–0.5% before declining again toward 2023. The black total line in the right chart closely tracks the sum of the stacked components, oscillating near zero for much of the period. The bars are not sorted but follow a chronological order, and no individual bars appear to be visually emphasized beyond the consistent color coding and the dashed Bahnreform reference line in both panels.
